name: Can I install a new roof over my old one?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a new roof over my old one?

acceptedAnswer.text: In some cases, a new roof can be installed directly over an existing one, known as a re-cover or layover. However, this is usually only permissible if your current roof has a single layer of shingles and the underlying structure is sound. Building codes often limit roofs to two layers. While it can be more cost-effective initially, a re-cover may not offer the same longevity or address underlying issues as a full tear-off and replacement. We can assess if this is an option for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can sometimes install a new roof over an existing single layer if the structure is sound, but a full tear-off is often recommended for longevity.
